{"sql":"SELECT pt.TrackId, t.Name AS TrackName, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.PlaylistId) AS PlaylistCount
FROM PlaylistTrack pt
JOIN Track t ON pt.TrackId = t.TrackId
GROUP BY pt.TrackId
ORDER BY PlaylistCount DESC, TrackName
LIMIT 10;"}
